title: Find the Index of the First Occurrence in a String
statement: Return the first index of needle in haystack, or -1 if needle is not a substring. Implement the search yourself. The Knuth-Morris-Pratt prefix table is the linear solution.
hints: The naive double loop compares needle at every alignment.
KMP builds a longest-prefix-that-is-suffix table for needle.
On a mismatch, the table says how far the pattern can shift without re-reading the text.

approaches.name: KMP
approaches.explanation: The prefix table plus one scan of the text.

editorial: Build lps where lps[i] is the longest proper prefix of needle[:i+1] that is also a suffix. Scan the haystack with a pattern index. On a match, advance both. On a mismatch, jump the pattern index to lps[pattern index - 1], or move the text index if the pattern index is already 0. When the pattern index reaches the needle length, the match started at text index minus that length.
